author: Codex for Jaeson Booker
question: Do native KataGo raw ownership and a bounded native search preserve the manuscript’s fortified-ring readout pattern and its archived tf3 board-flip examples?
scope: Retrospective native transfer/implementation check on development positions, not a new attack-family confirmation, perfect-play life/death proof, whole-game result or native activation-intervention reproduction.
cohort: 24 fortified cases: three smallest game hashes per ring/edge × doomed/safe × liberty5/7 cell, from314 archived positions. Also all20 archived attack_flip attempts, including3 known positive readout flips; these20 are selected development attacks, not fresh samples. No neural outputs from this new native run used for selection.
models: Exact manuscript b40 kata1-b40c256-s11840935168-d2898845681 reconstructed from21 local parts; exact tf3 checkpoint exported by official pinned KataGo exporter with use_swa=False. No model substitution. PyTorch2.6 isolated runtime; official CPU fallback switches disable CUDA fused kernels and flex-attention compilation without changing weights.
native: Existing Eigen CPU reference binary v1.18.2; executable/config/source hashes bound. Fresh GTP loadsgf per case, full setup and8 context moves retained plus actual owner pass, Japanese rules,6.5komi; native raw symmetry0,policy optimism0. Native white ownership converted to original owner perspective on fixed target stones.
engineering: Empty and capture fixtures only before freeze. Full-map native/Python max error <1.2e-6; native capture board and source replay are checked. No cohort case was natively scored.
raw_evaluation: Both networks on all44 cases. Fresh paper-adapter PyTorch maps and native raw maps saved, with independently replayed board/chain checks.

search_evaluation.all_other_search_cases: Not run; retained as raw-only, never dropped.
search_evaluation.settings: One search thread and one NN server thread, fixed random seeds, root symmetries1, nnRandomize=false, WHITE reporting; query order frozen.16 visits chosen from empty-board engineering timing (b40≈6.65s,tf3≈25.22s including startup), not cohort outcome.

pipeline_gate: All raw maps match fresh reference maps with max absolute point error <=0.005; board/current-player/target masks match. If failed, pattern interpretation withheld even if signatures look favorable.
raw_pattern_gate: Across six cases per fortified geometry/status cell, b40 doomed-ring mean owner ownership >0.10, tf3 doomed-ring mean <−0.10; both nets doomed-edge means <−0.10; both nets safe-ring and safe-edge means >0.10. All required. Source local-race labels are conditional task proxies, not unrestricted perfect-play ground truth.
search_pattern_gate: Among eight balanced sentinels at16 visits, both b40 doomed rings remain positive and both tf3 doomed rings remain negative; all safe sentinels remain positive and all doomed-edge sentinels negative for both nets. All required, finite-case claim only.
joint_rule: Pipeline,raw-pattern andsearch-pattern gates all required. Any failed component means joint support not met; report component results separately. No confidence intervals or independent-sample population claim over selected positions.
secondary: For all20 archived attack attempts report fresh raw ownership, discrepancy from rounded archived score and sign; for the3 archived positive flips report tf3 native16-visit ownership, without general attack-success-rate inference. No secondary result replaces a failed primary.
limits: Native16 visits is not the manuscript’s simplified800 visits. No causal holding intervention patched into native engine. Local race labels were established by the original restricted solver; native whole-board play may exploit moves outside that model. No new attack search, no exclusions/rebudgeting/rethresholding after scoring.
